{"tool":"inspect_model","signature":"inspect_model(document_id, view=None, branch=None, checks=None, options=None, show=None, hide=None)","doc":"See the generated part or design as an image with CAD measurements, and/or check manufacturability or fit.
A circuit gives its board, components (footprint, position), nets, routing and every diagnostic, with both its
schematic and its PCB image; review both (view "schematic" or "pcb" only to re-check one).

Generate first. While the full build still runs, a succeeded preview of the saved source answers measurements and
the interference, fasteners and machining checks (and is attached to the revision); views and manufacturability
checks wait for the full build, and when this call's wait ends first you get the preview's measurements with
still_working (call again to keep waiting). Without checks you get the isometric view (or `view`); use the numbers,
not pixels, for dimensions. Visibility (designs): show draws only these instances, hide draws all but these; each entry is an
instance name (read_design's instances), a component's name or id (all its instances) or a pattern ("wheel_*").
The camera frames what's drawn, and summary.drawn gives its instances and extent_mm/bounds_mm. Use it to check the
part an edit changed, e.g. show=["bracket"], or to see inside, e.g. view="front", hide=["housing", "cover_*"].
checks (exact B-rep; load the matching dfm/dfam skill to interpret): "dfam:fdm|sla|sls|mjf|metal_pbf",
"molding", "cnc", "sheet_metal". options override generic limits, e.g. {"build_direction": "+Z",
"pull_direction": "+Z", "tool_radius_mm": 3, "min_wall_mm": 1}. Findings name faces/edges with measured
value, limit and source; they are review evidence, not certification. branch: one of this document's branches.
"interference" (designs with design.fit_check in main.py): overlaps and clearances per instance pair, each new,
worse, unchanged or resolved against options {"base_revision": N} (default the previous revision), so only what
an edit broke fails; {"fit_check": name} picks one.
"fasteners" (designs with design.fasten in main.py): each declared screw's holes, seat, thread engagement,
bottoming, walls, clashes and driver access as built, pass/review/fail, with the holes each part wants;
{"fastener": name or pattern} picks some.
"machining": what a CAM program can target, named exactly as its targets take them: each instance's bodies, its
holes (Model.hole's wall, counterbore and countersink faces), its other round faces (fillets, bosses), and its
up-facing flats (height), with diameters, axes and positions in the design's mm (a round face's at_mm is the point
on its axis at its top end, length_mm its length along the axis)."}

schematic and its PCB image; review both (view "schematic" or "pcb" only to re-check one).
